forecasts.question: Will AGI be developed before 1 January 2030?
forecasts.key_change: Stable; Polymarket at 27% for OpenAI AGI announcement in 2026. Brockman claimed 70-80% progress but cognitive scientists dismissed. Metaculus median still mid-2030.
forecasts.base_rate: Metaculus community median: mid-2030 (50%); Polymarket 27% for OpenAI AGI announcement in 2026

factors_up.factor: OpenAI co-founder Brockman claimed 70-80% progress toward AGI in April 2026
AI self-improvement loop accelerating — AI writing AI code at scale

factors_down.factor: Cognitive scientists dismiss progress claims as incremental reasoning improvements
DeepMind 10-trait framework highlights remaining gaps in autonomy, meta-learning
Only 3.7 years remain — very short timeline for paradigm shift

key_uncertainties: Whether current scaling improvements constitute path to AGI or asymptote
update_triggers_up: Major lab demonstrates autonomous long-horizon research

forecasts.question: Will economic consultancy lose ≥33% value/jobs by end 2030 due to AI?
forecasts.key_change: Stable; UK consulting market projecting 5.7% revenue growth in 2026 despite McKinsey and Big Four restructuring. Revenue growing even as headcount shifts.
forecasts.base_rate: No precedent for 33% industry decline in 4-5 years; consulting market growing 2-6% CAGR

factors_up.factor: McKinsey cutting ~10% workforce; 200 tech staff laid off
65% of enterprises say traditional consulting no longer delivers value
Deloitte scrapping traditional job titles; pyramid model under stress

factors_down.factor: UK consulting market growing from $27.2B to $28B in 2026
AI deployment generates consulting demand
Top firms restructuring toward AI advisory — adapting not shrinking

key_uncertainties: Whether revenue growth masks fundamental value erosion
Speed of enterprise shift from consultants to AI tools
update_triggers_up: Major firm reports revenue decline >10% YoY from AI
update_triggers_down: Industry revenue hits new all-time high
AI advisory revenue exceeds traditional losses

forecasts.question: Will Labour be largest party at next UK General Election?
forecasts.key_change: ↓ YouGov April 7 shows Labour at 16%, tied with Greens. Electoral Calculus projects Labour fifth with 63 seats. Reform leads at 266 seats.
forecasts.base_rate: Incumbents win most seats ~60% of post-war UK elections, but Labour deficit unprecedented

factors_up.factor: 3+ years until election deadline (Dec 2029)
Reform doubts on readiness for government

factors_down.factor: Labour at 16-17.8% across polls, fifth in seat projections (63 seats)
Multi-party fragmentation: Reform 24-26%, Tories 18-19%, Greens 16-17%
Green surge taking 68 Labour seats directly

key_uncertainties: Whether Reform maintains lead through to election
update_triggers_up: Labour leadership change boosts polls above 25%
update_triggers_down: Early election called at historic lows

forecasts.question: Will AGI be developed before 1 January 2035?
forecasts.key_change: Stable; Metaculus median mid-2030 places ~50% at this deadline. Brockman 70-80% progress claim adds modest upward pressure on longer horizon.
forecasts.base_rate: Metaculus median for AGI: mid-2030, implying ~50% by 2035

factors_up.factor: 8.7 years is substantially longer horizon than 2030 question
AI capability gains accelerating across coding, reasoning, multimodal
Multiple labs investing $10B+ annually in frontier research

factors_down.factor: Remaining gaps in autonomy, social intelligence, meta-learning
Evaluation frameworks highlighting what current systems cannot do

key_uncertainties: Whether current paradigm leads to AGI or requires new approaches
update_triggers_up: Autonomous AI research agent produces novel results
update_triggers_down: Plateau in frontier capabilities over 12+ months

forecasts.question: Will China initiate a military blockade or invasion of Taiwan before 1 January 2030?
forecasts.key_change: ↓ PRC reduced daily military coercion to avoid strengthening DPP defense argument; diplomatic engagement with Trump ongoing. Defense budget up 7% but operational tempo down.
forecasts.base_rate: Historical great-power confrontation: ~2-5%/year; superforecaster consensus ~10-15% by 2030

factors_up.factor: PRC defense budget up 7% to $278B in 2026
Dec 2025 exercises rehearsed full blockade
Coast guard increasing presence around Taiwan

factors_down.factor: PRC reduced ADIZ incursions to lowest since early 2020s
Economic costs $2-10T remain strong deterrent
Xi-Trump diplomatic engagement; PRC avoiding provocation
ASPI: 2026 not the year; military purges reduced capability

key_uncertainties: Whether diplomatic engagement is genuine de-escalation
Potential for rapid escalation from incident
update_triggers_down: Formal US-China agreement on status quo

forecasts.question: Will UK annual CPI inflation fall below 2.0% for at least one month before 1 January 2027?
forecasts.key_change: Stable at floor; BoE expects CPI 3-3.5% through Q2-Q3 2026 due to Middle East energy shock. March likely ~3.5%. Only 8 months remain.
forecasts.base_rate: UK CPI below 2.0% in only 4 of last 120 months; current level 3.0% and rising
forecasts.base_rate_source: ONS CPI data, BoE MPR February 2026

factors_up.factor: Dramatic global energy price collapse could theoretically pull CPI down

factors_down.factor: CPI at 3.0% in Feb, expected to rise to 3.5% in March
BoE projects 3-3.5% through Q2-Q3 due to Middle East energy shock
Core inflation rising to 3.2% — underlying pressures persistent
Only 8 readings remain; need 150bps drop from trajectory

forecasts.question: Will Spider-Man: Brand New Day gross over $1.5B worldwide by 31 December 2026?
forecasts.key_change: Stable; trailer at 1 BILLION views (first ever). Projections $2.3-2.5B worldwide. Release July 31 gives 5 months. Polymarket 45.5% chance of #1 film of year.
forecasts.base_rate: No Way Home earned $1.92B; MCU films with strong franchise momentum ~85-90% clear $1.5B
forecasts.base_rate_source: Box Office Mojo, The Numbers, Variety

factors_up.factor: First trailer to hit 1 BILLION views — unprecedented
Projections $971M domestic, $2.31-2.54B worldwide
Strong cast + multiverse storyline continuation
July 31 release gives 5 months before deadline

factors_down.factor: MCU fatigue could dampen turnout vs trailer interest
Competition from Avengers: Doomsday

key_uncertainties: Whether trailer views translate proportionally to box office

forecasts.question: Will OpenAI and Anthropic have a combined ARR exceeding $70B by 31 December 2026?
forecasts.key_change: ↑ Anthropic passed OpenAI — now $30B ARR vs OpenAI $25B. Combined $55B, need $15B more in 8 months. Anthropic grew $21B in 4 months.
forecasts.base_rate: Combined ARR $55B April 2026; need $70B by Dec; growth needed: ~3.0% monthly compound

factors_up.factor: Anthropic $30B ARR, surpassing OpenAI — grew $21B in ~4 months
OpenAI at $25B growing $2B/month — would reach $41B by Dec alone
Enterprise adoption accelerating: 1,000+ customers >$1M/yr at Anthropic
Current trajectories: Anthropic ~$50B + OpenAI ~$41B = $91B by Dec

factors_down.factor: Growth deceleration normal as base grows
Enterprise contracts have seasonal patterns

forecasts.question: Will UK average annual real GDP growth exceed 1.5% across the 2030s (2030-2039)?
forecasts.key_change: ↓ OBR March 2026 projects only 1.1% growth in 2026 before recovering to 1.6% average. BoE sees subdued underlying growth. Productivity assumption unproven.
forecasts.base_rate: UK avg real GDP growth: 2010s ~1.8%, 2000s ~1.8%; OBR medium-term: 1.6%
forecasts.base_rate_source: OBR EFO March 2026, ONS GDP data

factors_up.factor: OBR forecasts 1.6% average over medium-term horizon
AI productivity gains could boost trend growth in 2030s
Government infrastructure and green investment plans

factors_down.factor: 2026 growth only 1.1% — weak starting point
OBR productivity assumption (1%) optimistic vs post-2008 record
Population ageing + declining migration reduces labour supply to 0.5% by 2030
EY forecasts 1.4% from 2028 — below threshold

key_uncertainties: Whether AI delivers measurable productivity growth
